title: Speaking Practice 6 - Music and Entertainment
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about music preferences and entertainment.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Music and Entertainment
stimuli.content: Answer questions about your music preferences and entertainment choices.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about music.

questions.content: What type of music do you enjoy listening to?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I mostly listen to pop and indie music. Artists like Sơn Tùng M-TP and international bands like Coldplay are my favorites.

questions.content: Do you play any musical instruments?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I learned to play the guitar when I was in high school, though I don't practice as much anymore. I can still play a few songs.
explanation.tips: Be specific about your experience level

questions.content: Has your taste in music changed over the years?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, quite a lot. When I was younger I only listened to pop music, but now I appreciate jazz and classical music as well.

questions.content: Do you prefer watching movies at home or in the cinema?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I prefer the cinema for action films because of the big screen and sound quality, but for dramas I enjoy watching at home where I can pause and relax.

questions.content: What was the last concert or live event you attended?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I went to a music festival in Ho Chi Minh City last year. It had both local and international artists performing, and the atmosphere was incredible.
